preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k == 0 and n % 2 != 0 else True
postconditions.description: If k is zero and n is odd, output -1 indicating no valid sequence exists.

postconditions.expression: len(set(stdout.split())) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output must contain n distinct integers, each between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: sum(gcd(int(x), int(y)) for x, y in zip(stdout.split(), stdout.split()[1:])) == k
postconditions.description: The total points scored by Bimokh, which is the sum of gcds of consecutive pairs of integers in the output, must equal k.
